title: NEW aircraft & liveries just dropped in MSFS 2024 marketplace week 13
description:
The Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Marketplace Update for March 28, 2026 is here, featuring the brand new Carenado B200! In this MSFS 2024 Marketplace Update, we explore the Carenado B200 (Classic twin-engine turboprop) and the latest MSFS 2024 liveries for PC.

On March 28, 2026, this week’s Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Marketplace Update brings a must-have turboprop to your hangar with the newly released Carenado B200. We also have a fresh batch of MSFS 2024 liveries for your favorite aircraft!

✈️ New aircrafts added this week (PC)
The following aircrafts were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🛫 Carenado: B200 (Classic twin‑engine turboprop for regional and business ops)

🎨 New Liveries added this week (PC)
The following liveries were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🎨 STOL Addicts: DHC-2 Beaver GT Series (Enhanced liveries for rugged bush flying)
🎨 STOL Addicts: DHC-2 Hot Rods Livery Pack (Stylised performance‑inspired paint schemes)
🎨 HRSimYard: H125 Austrian Livery Pack (Austria‑themed helicopter liveries)
🎨 HRSimYard: H125 Italian Livery Pack (Italy‑themed helicopter liveries)
🎨 HRSimYard: H125 Swiss Livery Pack (Switzerland‑themed helicopter liveries)
🎨 STOL Addicts: STOL Addicts HJet Livery Pack Infinitum (Expanded HJet visual variety)

If you enjoy staying up‑to‑date with all the latest MSFS 2024 Marketplace releases, make sure to like the video, subscribe to the channel, and drop a comment below letting us know if the B200 is making its way into your fleet this week!

✈️ See you in the skies!
